notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
Overgrown Arch does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Overgrown Arch.
description:
Activate Overgrown Arch's first ability by tapping it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Overgrown Arch.
Repeat.
